title: Facilities services operative
change: Occupational Standard and Assessment plan revised.
overviewOfRole: Providing facilities services support to customers and facilities management departments.

knowledges.detail: Health and safety regulations, standards, and guidance and impact on role, for example display screen equipment, manual handling, fire reform order, legionella.
Safe systems of work, hazards, risk assessments, method statements and control measures.
Principles and techniques of waste management hierarchy.
Sustainability practices and techniques.
The key components of corporate social responsibility, for example, people, planet, profit.
The facilities sector. In-house and outsourced model.  Types of employers. Types of customers and stakeholders.
The purpose and benefits of standard operating procedures (SOP).
Principles and practices of service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs) and contractual obligations.
Limits of authority and escalation procedures.
Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and organisational policy for customer service
Considerations for resource management: cost, quality, safety, security, and environmental impact.
Requirements and techniques involved in work planning, sequencing and pre work checking.
Problem solving methods, for example, decision tree, plan, do, check, act (PDCA).
Principles of equity, diversity and inclusion in the workplace and the impact on their work.
Team working and collaborative working techniques: customers, colleagues, internal and external stakeholders.
Information technology and digital systems used to support facilities management operations. General data protection regulation (GDPR). Cyber security.
Written communication techniques: paper based and digital. Plain English principles. Sector specific terminology.
Verbal communication techniques. Giving and receiving information. Adapting style to audience. Barriers in communication and how to overcome them. Sector specific terminology.
Documentation: methods and requirements – electronic and paper, for example, text, data, job card, work instructions, risk assessments, method statements, operation manuals, permits to work.
Principles of hard facilities management.
Principles of soft facilities management.
Site emergency and evacuation procedures.
The different types of maintenance, for example planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance.
Organisation’s standard operating procedure (SOP) and standards for housekeeping, limits of organisational responsibility.
Premises and equipment inspections, their purpose and recording methods.

behaviours.detail: Contributes to equity, diversity and inclusivity.
Respond and adapt to work demands and situations

skills.detail: Follow procedures in line with health and safety regulations, standards, and guidance.
Identify and report hazards and risks in the workplace. Comply with safe systems of work and apply control measures.
Deliver customer service, in accordance with SOPs and organisational policy.
Schedule, prioritise and sequence work in line with requirements.
Apply problem solving methods, identifying issues. Propose solutions to problems.
Follow equity, diversity and inclusion rules.
Apply team working and collaborate with others.
Use information technology and digital systems. Comply with GDPR and cyber security regulations and polices.
Communicate in writing with others for example, internal and external customers, colleagues, and managers.
Communicate with others verbally including internal and external customers, colleagues using sector specific terminology.
Record or enter information - paper based or electronic.
Apply the site emergency and evacuation procedures.
Conduct housekeeping within the areas of responsibility meets required standards of tidiness and presentation in accordance with SOPs.
Carry out and record premises and equipment inspections.

duties.dutyDetail: Support the delivery of health, safety, welfare and security for all facilities users.
Support the organisation to reduce business risk.
Contribute to maintaining sustainable practices in the delivery of facilities management services.
Provide customer services to building users, to support the effective delivery of facilities services.
Support and maintain the delivery of day-to-day facilities management services.
Contribute towards the delivery of facilities management projects or building change.
Gather facilities management related information to inform the maintenance and improvement of services.
Develop and maintain own competence in the facilities management sector.
